title: Hopper Totem
description: 🔁 Hopper Totem Resource Pack Turn your Totem of Undying into a quirky hopper companion!
body:
🔁 Hopper Totem Resource Pack
Turn your Totem of Undying into a quirky hopper companion!
This pack transforms the totem into a miniature hopper — perfect for redstone lovers, industrial builders, or anyone who thinks survival deserves a bit of automation flair.
🎮 Works in all versions that support custom models (1.14+).
🪄 Simple, clean, and 100% vanilla-friendly.
